module origen_212266 (
    input [7:0] din,
    input wr_en,
    input clk_50m,
    input clken,
    output reg tx,
    output reg tx_busy
);

localparam STATE_IDLE  = 2'b00;
localparam STATE_START = 2'b01;
localparam STATE_DATA  = 2'b10;
localparam STATE_STOP  = 2'b11;

reg [1:0] state;
reg [2:0] bitpos;
reg [7:0] data;

always @(posedge clk_50m) begin
    if (!clken) begin
        // Do nothing
    end else begin
        case (state)
            STATE_IDLE: begin
                tx_busy <= 1'b0;
                if (wr_en) begin
                    data <= din;
                    state <= STATE_START;
                    tx_busy <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
            STATE_START: begin
                tx <= 1'b0; // Start bit
                state <= STATE_DATA;
                bitpos <= 0;
            end
            STATE_DATA: begin
                tx <= data[bitpos];
                if (bitpos == 7) begin
                    state <= STATE_STOP;
                end else begin
                    bitpos <= bitpos + 1;
                end
            end
            STATE_STOP: begin
                tx <= 1'b1; // Stop bit
                state <= STATE_IDLE;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
